content.comment_body: I can manually switch between ADMIN and OP modes on my hardware ([article_no]), but I want to know if this can be done from [product_name] software over Ethernet.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is successfully switching between ADMIN and OP modes directly on their device ([article_no]) and wants to know if the same can be done remotely through [product_name] software using Ethernet. Another user clarified that remote switching via the software is not supported, highlighting a limitation of remote control functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to switch between ADMIN and OP modes remotely using [product_name] software and Ethernet.
